description: The version of this contract, the report schema versions it accepts and the operating systems a released analyzer supports. contract_version is the semantic version of the contract as one unit, independent of every analyzer's version and of this repository's release tags; it moves only when a document under contract/ changes in a way an implementation can observe, by its minor number for every such change, a move of a schema_versions value included, because schema_versions is the value a consumer gates on and it already carries the breaking fact, and by its major number only when a mechanism text changes so that a conformance run of an implementation that conformed before the change can fail; every analyzer names the contract version it implements in its report and in its resolved configuration. schema_versions lists every value a report's schema_version field may carry under this contract version; a merge admits a report whose schema_version is in this list and refuses one that is not, naming both versions. A value moves when the report a consumer decodes changes shape: its major number when a member changes type, is added as required or stops being required, and its minor number when an optional member is added or an enumeration gains a value; a report is written to one shape, so a value is replaced rather than joined by a second unless this contract version admits two shapes at once. This version admits one. platforms is the closed set of operating systems every product supports, each spelled as the os field of a report configuration spells it; the set names operating systems only.
